SPY.title: US Stocks Likely To See Tepid Opening As Bitcoin Blasts Through $103,000: Investors Eye Jobless Claims Data While BlackRock Expects 'US Exceptionalism' To Power Earnings In 2025
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures are trading lower on Thursday as investors await jobless claims data and digest comments from Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell. Bitcoin surged past $103,000 for the first time, boosting shares of MicroStrategy and Coinbase.
SPY.author: Rounak Jain
